verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat answers natural-language questions by searching across a user's meetings, and the enterprise page repeats that past calls can be queried in natural language. This covers the core ask-your-meeting-history workflow. However, nothing in the evidence shows answers come with source citations or links back to the specific meetings or transcript moments, and there is no hands-on corroboration of answer quality. The all-time-periods search claim refers to the MCP server rather than Otter's own chat. missing for 10: documented source attribution or citations in AI Chat answers, explicit confirmation that AI Chat itself spans the full meeting history, independent or hands-on corroboration of answer accuracy.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Otter AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to instantly answer questions
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods
